questions.prompt: Is the reason we entered this position (`entry.sig`, `entry.why`) still valid? Goal: we hold an open position (`pos`). Decide whether to keep holding or close it now. You can only hold or close the whole position; the stop is never widened and size is never added. A wrong close costs fees and the remaining move; a wrong hold can cost up to the stop. Field glossary. Units: `*_bps` = basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), `*_k` = thousand USDT, `*_x` = multiple of the recent average; signed values are positive when up / buying. `sym` = the coin; `px` = last price (USDT); `atr_bps` = ATR in bps; `ret1m_bps`/`ret5m_bps` = price change over 1/5 minutes; `rv5m_bps` = 5-minute realized volatility; `vol_x` = 1-minute volume, `vol10_x` = last 10s volume scaled to 1 minute; `buy` = taker buy share of 1-minute volume (0-1, 0.5 = equal buy and sell); `cvd30_k` = taker buy minus sell over the last 30s; `liq_long_k`/`liq_short_k` = long / short liquidations in the last minute; `fund_bps` = funding rate (positive = longs pay shorts). Derivatives, when present: `oi15`/`oi60`/`oi4h` = open interest change % over 15m/60m/4h; `top_ls`/`crowd_ls` = top-trader position and all-account long/short ratios (above 1 = more long); `div4h` = top minus crowd 4h change %; `btc5z` = BTC 5-minute move in noise units (positive = BTC up). `book` = order book: `spread_bps` = bid-ask spread, `ofi_k` = order-flow imbalance (positive = net buying), `depth_k` = resting depth near the price. `pos` = our position: `side` long/short; `entry_px` = entry price; `pnl_bps` = unrealized PnL before fees (positive = profit); `age_min` = minutes held; `time_left_min` = minutes until the time-limit close; `to_stop_bps`/`to_tp_bps` = distance from price to the stop / take-profit; `peak_bps` = best unrealized PnL so far, `giveback_bps` = how much of that peak is gone; `pnl_r`/`peak_r` = the same in units of the initial stop distance (-1 = at the stop); `be_bps` = PnL after round-trip taker fees (about 10 bps); `path_bps` = unrealized PnL at earlier checks, oldest first. `entry` = why we entered: `sig` = signal type, `why` = trigger text. `trail` = trailing stop: `on` = configured, `active` = armed, `stop_bps` = PnL bps left before it is hit. `card` = today's strategist plan for this coin: `bias` long/short/both/no_trade; `levels_bps` = key levels as bps from price (negative = below); `stop_atr` = stop range in `atr_bps` multiples; `tp_r` = take-profit range in stop distances; `size_max` = largest size tier (S/M/L); `regime` = the strategist's market notes; `source_market_view_id` = the market view it was built on; `status` none / symbol_not_in_card = no plan for this coin. `current_market` = the latest market-wide view: `regime` text, `regime_direction` (看涨 bullish / 看跌 bearish / 中性 neutral), `market_view_id`/`version`, `observed_at`/`source_ts` = UTC times, `within_4h` = short-term outlook text, `age_min` = minutes since published, `stale` = present when older than the configured maximum age. `kronos.p_up` = the forecast model's probability (0-1) that price is higher at the end of its horizon; `kronos.rank` = where this coin's forecast return ranks among all coins forecast now (top/mid/bottom); `against` (only on urgent checks) = a rule trigger whose side differs from `pos.side`: `sig` = its type, `side`, `vol_x` = volume multiple, `buy` = taker buy share, `strong` = one of the strong trigger types, `age_s` = seconds ago.
How likely is a sharp move against the position in the next few minutes?
Hold the whole position or close all of it now? A wrong close costs fees plus the move we miss; a wrong hold costs the adverse move up to the stop.
